dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with jagged edge geometry. Clear high-contrast gradient transition from high-intensity white/light-grey outer rings to lower-intensity dark-grey interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-to-moderate density of localized, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated between larger macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent mid-lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with a fourth centroid posteriorly situated forming an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: Dendritic, high-contrast linear structures extending from the posterior annuli toward the hind flipper.
